# fxr

`fxr.js` is `dist/fxr.js` from the npm package `@cccode/fxr` 32.1.3 by EvenTorset (https://github.com/EvenTorset/fxr),
released under the Unlicense (see LICENSE). The porter runs it with Jint to read DS3 effects and write them for
Elden Ring (Effects/FxrPort.cs, Effects/fxr-port.js). Added with Devin's approval on 2026-10-31.
